## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 3dc5041e20f5949a6773fa00fab20aa6af60ab14

## Reasoning
**
(1) Investigation:** I ran `git log -p --follow` on `src/org/exist/jetty/JettyStart.java` to trace the history of the "[eXist Home : ...]" log line back
through renames (the file was originally `src/org/exist/JettyStart.java`). This showed every histor

ical form of the line, letting me find the exact commit that changed how `exist.home` was retrieved.

**(2) The introducing change:** Commit `3dc5041e2
` ("[bugfix] Ensure access to org/exist/system.properties is consistent and is not loaded more times than necessary, also default
values should be available in its absence", 2011-04-19) refactored `JettyStart.java` to route all of the startup banner's property

lookups (`product-version`, `product-build`, `exist.home`, `svn-revision`) through the new `SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty(...)` helper, which reads from the bundled resource file `src/org/ex

ist/system.properties`. Before this commit, `exist.home` was read correctly via `System.getProperty("exist.home")` (a JVM system property set at process launch). The refactor incorrectly lumped `exist.home`
in with the build-time constants (version/build/revision), even though it is a runtime-only property that is never written

into `system.properties`.

**(3) Supporting evidence:**
- `src/org/exist/system.properties` (both at HEAD and at the introducing commit) only contains `vendor`, `vendor-url`, `product

-name`, `product-version`, `product-semver`, `product-build`, `git-commit` — never `exist.home`.
- `SystemProperties.getSystemProperty()` loads exclusively from this classpath resource,

so any lookup of `exist.home` through it will always fall through to the `"unknown"` default.
- The bug-fixing commit (`a8726
173a`, 2016) explicitly reverts this specific line back to `System.getProperty("exist.home", "unknown")`, leaving the other three lookups (`product-version`, `product-build`, `git
-commit`) untouched — confirming that only the `exist.home` lookup mechanism was wrong, exactly matching what commit `3dc5041e2` bro

ke 5 years earlier.

I'm confident in this identification — the fix commit's message ("exist.home is not in src/org/exist/system.properties") directly names the root cause, and
the history trace pinpoints exactly one commit that introduced the faulty lookup mechanism for that property.
